badge_en: Electric Mobility & Clean Energy Retail · CLAC25
badge_es: Movilidad Eléctrica y Energía Limpia · CLAC25
hero_sub_en: moviltronics.com · Colombia · Bogotá · Stage: Pre-Seed · CT-TR-001
hero_sub_es: moviltronics.com · Colombia · Bogotá · Etapa: Pre-Seed · CT-TR-001
pitch_en: Importer and retailer of electric motorcycles, e-bikes, solar components, and electronic parts for makers and EV conversion projects across Colombia.
pitch_es: Importador y minorista de motocicletas eléctricas, e-bikes, componentes solares y partes electrónicas para makers y proyectos de conversión EV en Colombia.
cta_pitch_en: CleantechHUB CLAC25 portfolio card — enabling accessible electric mobility and renewable components.
cta_pitch_es: Tarjeta de portafolio CLAC25 CleantechHUB — habilitando movilidad eléctrica accesible y componentes renovables.

sections.head_en: Colombian consumers and makers lack accessible supply chains for electric mobility and solar components.
sections.head_es: Consumidores y makers en Colombia carecen de cadenas de suministro accesibles para movilidad eléctrica y componentes solares.
sections.body_en: Fragmented imports, financing gaps, and limited local parts availability slow EV adoption and DIY clean-energy projects.
sections.body_es: Importaciones fragmentadas, brechas de financiamiento y disponibilidad limitada de repuestos locales frenan la adopción de EV y proyectos de energía limpia.

steps.text_en: Retail and import of e-motorcycles, e-bikes, batteries, chargers, motors, and solar equipment.
steps.text_es: Retail and import of e-motorcycles, e-bikes, batteries, chargers, motors, and solar equipment.

steps.text_en: Based in Bogotá, Colombia. Public site: moviltronics.com.
steps.text_es: Based in Bogotá, Colombia. Public site: moviltronics.com.

cards.text_en: Nexus card: electric mobility retailer/importer for makers and EV conversions.
cards.text_es: Nexus card: electric mobility retailer/importer for makers and EV conversions.

cards.text_en: CT-TR-001 (Sustainable Transport) and CT-EN-001 (Energy Generation & Distribution).
